newsitem.title: CANADA: CP reopens Canadian mountain rail line.
newsitem.headline: CP reopens Canadian mountain rail line.

text.p: CP Rail System punched through avalanches to reopen its main rail line through the Fraser River Valley in the Rocky Mountains on Saturday, CP spokesman Steve Morris said.
Heavy snow and avalanches had closed CP's line and that of Canadian National Railway Co on December 31. CN managed to open its line on Friday.
The two lines were the main rail link from the prairies to Vancouver, and the avalanches had halted grain shipments.
Grain loading on to ocean vessels in Vancouver had proceeded unhindered due to adequate terminal elevator stocks, the Canadian Wheat Board said on Friday.
The first trains to move headed east from Vancouver to clear space there. Trains carrying grain, containers and trailers were the first to move out of Calgary westward towards Vancouver, Morris said.
